T1.unit: T1: S_FIFO price-priority exhaustion claims (strictly-better makers); violation = the hash fills again later

T2.unit: T2: records with >= 2 worst-price makers; violation = >= 2 of them fill again later

R1.coverage_scenario_rule: S_NOPRIO if any test is contradicted, else S_FIFO (declaration R1)
R1.rule: INSUFFICIENT if den < 200; supported if rate <= 0.01; contradicted otherwise

R2.caveat: outcome-selected: only filled orders print a public hash, so the scored population is our FILLED orders only; unfilled orders and their lifecycles are not scored (declaration R2)
R2.clock_premise: one constant bot-to-venue offset within each run (each run its own bot clock) | a notice is received after its status second starts | a match follows its placement and precedes the end of its Matched second | activation in [signed, Accepted answer received] | a cancel takes effect in [request, first Canceled answer received] | NOT ESTABLISHED: the lifecycle venue book / UUID / collector clocks equal the venue status clock
R2.rule: a defect = a failed observed / constrained claim; no_defect iff 0 defects (fills block included); each defective (field, class) of an R3 class column is demoted to assumption_sensitive (computed flag; inputs never edited)

unique_defects.rule: truth v2 unique_defects (distinct (mid, order hash, defect field) over every scenario), recomputed from defect_rows

R3.scope: BOOK markets, pooled days, both sides

checks.share_matched: rt_pnl_res / gross_res on resolved markets (res_status in RES_VALID; equal to econ maker_day rt_pnl_res, checked)

R4.note: point estimates per day; no intervals below 5 complete UTC days (rule 8)

resolution_null_rule.declared: before any real output was read
resolution_null_rule.statistic: sum NP_m (V_m - m_END_m) over fifo-ok markets

counterparty.rule: one_sided = >= 0.95 of the ok shares in one role (maker / taker) or one YES direction, with >= 10 ok fills

rank_persistence.rule: rank -1 = not ranked that day; ID-day ranks checked against identities.json

rewards.statement: per-maker rewards are unidentifiable from public data: the pool is per market (units unverified); BOOK eligible share-seconds are an upper bound and the demonstrated set presence a lower bound; no reward is attributed to an address

20261024.rule: most maker legs (lifecycle fills rows) of the two top-ranked exante_sh addresses; ties -> smallest mid
